skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will understand the basic concepts of e-commerce, including its models, stages of development, and types.
Students will be able to apply the transaction processes with end customers and businesses.
Students will learn to analyze various e-commerce business models such as B2C, B2B2C, and B2B.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Selecting appropriate solutions for e-commerce implementation
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to evaluate and choose suitable solutions for implementing e-commerce activities, including hardware, software, payment systems, cybersecurity, and digital marketing strategies.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Collecting and synthesizing information on e-commerce
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will practice collecting and synthesizing information related to e-commerce, legal regulations, and economic and social conditions affecting e-commerce activities.
Students will develop teamwork skills through group projects and presentations.
Students will practice listening skills and asking relevant questions during lectures and seminars.
Students will demonstrate the ability to independently study materials, complete assignments, and adhere to class rules.

minimum_entry_skills.skill_name: Familiarity with computer networks and internet technologies
